boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented Grinnell College study settings, spanning digital production stations, collaborative rooms, quiet library seating, flexible indoor spaces, and powered outdoor classrooms.

cards.title: Edit at a Mac Workstation
cards.subtitle: Digital production space on Burling Library’s lower level
cards.notes: Bring a media project and start at one of seven Mac workstations; ask the circulation desk about cameras, recorders, or other checkout gear.
cards.short_summary: A first-come digital workspace equipped for video editing, scanning, and media-production assignments.
cards.evidence_claim: Grinnell College states that the lower-level Burling Digital Studio has seven Mac workstations with video-editing capabilities and a scanner station, with additional technology available for checkout.
cards.access_notes: Use is first-come, first-served; checkout equipment is available through the circulation desk.

cards.title: Cover the Whiteboard Together
cards.subtitle: Four enclosed collaboration rooms on Burling’s second level
cards.notes: Bring a group of four or five and use the floor-to-ceiling whiteboards; choose a monitor-equipped room when you need to share a screen.
cards.short_summary: Glass-enclosed rooms pair small-group tables with expansive writing surfaces and, in most rooms, wireless displays.
cards.evidence_claim: Grinnell College documents four private group study rooms on Burling Library’s second level; each seats four or five, all have floor-to-ceiling whiteboards, and three have Airtame-equipped monitors.
cards.access_notes: The rooms are currently available on a first-come, first-served basis.

cards.title: Settle In Between Events
cards.subtitle: Flexible lounge and event space near Burling’s north entrance
cards.notes: Check whether an event is scheduled, then use the lounge for solo reading or a group session when the room is open for study.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor lounge that shifts from programmed events to an informal individual or collaborative workspace.
cards.evidence_claim: Grinnell College identifies Burling Lounge, on the first level’s west side inside the north entrance, as both a study and event space available for individual or group study when no event is scheduled.
cards.access_notes: Study use is first-come, first-served and available only when an event is not scheduled.

cards.title: Choose a Booth or Soft Seat
cards.subtitle: Reconfigured computer commons on Burling’s first-floor east side
cards.notes: Use a booth or soft seat for laptop work, and confirm the computers are not reserved for a class before settling at a workstation.
cards.short_summary: An updated first-floor commons offering booths, softer seating, computers, and upgraded technology.
cards.evidence_claim: Grinnell College says Burling Commons occupies the first floor’s east side and has been reconfigured with new booths, soft seating options, and upgraded technology.
cards.access_notes: Study use is first-come, first-served and permitted when the computers are not being used for a class.

cards.title: Reconfigure the Tables
cards.subtitle: Convertible classroom and evening study room in Burling Library
cards.notes: Arrange the mobile tables for your group and pull over a whiteboard; verify that no class is using the room before beginning work.
cards.short_summary: A flexible classroom-study hybrid with movable two-person tables and several mobile whiteboards.
cards.evidence_claim: Grinnell College states that Burling’s second-floor classroom/study space contains 12 mobile tables seating two people each and several mobile whiteboards.
cards.access_notes: Study use is first-come, first-served during evenings and weekends or whenever the classroom is not in use.

cards.entity_name: Kistle Science Library Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Practice the Presentation
cards.subtitle: Four collaborative rooms inside Kistle Science Library
cards.notes: Choose the projector-equipped room when rehearsing slides; connect the installed computer or bring a compatible personal laptop.
cards.short_summary: Four science-library rooms support collaborative work, including one configured for projected presentations.
cards.evidence_claim: Grinnell College documents four group study rooms in Kistle Science Library and says one has a projector connectable to either the existing computer or a personal laptop.
cards.access_notes: All four Kistle group study rooms are available on a first-come, first-served basis.

cards.title: Read on the First or Second Floor
cards.subtitle: Dedicated reading areas within Grinnell’s main library
cards.notes: Choose a first- or second-floor reading area for sustained reading, or move to a study carrel when your work needs a more defined station.
cards.short_summary: Purpose-built reading areas and distributed carrels provide alternatives to Burling’s collaborative rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Grinnell College’s Burling Library page documents reading areas on the first and second floors and study carrels throughout the building.
cards.access_notes: Burling is accessed from 6th Avenue; consult current library information before visiting for building access or hours.

cards.entity_name: Humanities and Social Studies Center Atrium
cards.title: Work Across the Three-Story Atrium
cards.subtitle: Shared study setting linking HSSC’s historic and modern pavilions
cards.notes: Use the atrium for informal work near the HSSC’s academic activity, and shift to a semi-private breakout space for project discussion.
cards.short_summary: A central three-story interior links four pavilions and supports informal, collaborative academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: Grinnell College describes the HSSC’s three-story atrium as linking two renovated buildings with two new pavilions and providing study spaces.
cards.access_notes: The College presents the atrium on its after-hours visit page; observe posted building-access restrictions when entering.

cards.entity_name: Kenneth A. Christiansen Outdoor Learning Spaces
cards.title: Plug In Outside the HSSC
cards.subtitle: Four accessible outdoor learning areas with power and Wi-Fi
cards.notes: Bring a charged device and weather-ready materials; use the installed power and campus Wi-Fi while yielding any area reserved for a class.
cards.short_summary: Four purpose-designed outdoor classrooms combine open air with electrical service and wireless connectivity.
cards.evidence_claim: Grinnell College documents four Kenneth A. Christiansen Outdoor Learning Spaces near the HSSC that are accessible and have electrical utilities; the HSSC space page also states they provide Wi-Fi and power.
cards.access_notes: The four areas can accommodate as many as four classes at once; defer to scheduled instructional use.

cards.title: Take Coursework onto the Plaza
cards.subtitle: Outdoor study area beside the Humanities and Social Studies Center
cards.notes: Pick a weather-suitable time for reading or discussion, keep circulation routes clear, and relocate if a class is using the plaza.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor HSSC-adjacent plaza explicitly presented by the College as a place for studying and classes.
cards.evidence_claim: Grinnell College identifies Kington Plaza outside the HSSC as a place to study, spend time between classes, or attend a class.
cards.access_notes: This is an outdoor campus space; account for weather and yield to any scheduled class or posted restriction.
